correctness.rationale: For uniform unrooted two-component spanning forests of K_n, Cayley–Lagrange gives A_n=(n-1)(n+6)n^{n-4}/2, and the marked size law is C(n-1,q-1)tau(q)tau(n-q)/A_n. Conditional on Q=q the marked tree is uniform, so Prüfer yields D=0 at q=1 and 1+Bin(q−2,1/q) otherwise; the q→q+1 likelihood ratios are strictly increasing. Exchangeability Σ_v1/|C_v|=2 and the joining-edge bijection yield E(1/Q)=2/n and E S=4n/(n+6), hence Cov(D,S)=−2(n−2)/(n+6). Kassel–Kenyon–Wu Theorem 3 gives E[S(S−1)] and Var S∼2n; conditional binomial moments give Var D→1, proving Corr(D,S)∼−sqrt(2/n). Independent exact rational sums verified normalization, E(1/Q), E S and covariance for n=2..9; n=2 correlation explicitly undefined.
